date.as_written: paṃcāgnyaśvaikasaṃyukte śāke ... pakṣe durgāpriye bhaume caturthyāṃ divase tithau

purpose: svārtha: copied out of a wish to learn the text (vyutpattikāmena), to please Vāgīśvarī
notes: The chronogram pañca(5)-agni(3)-aśva(7)-eka(1), read right to left, gives Śaka 1735, which is CE 1813/14. This matches the catalogue. Read literally, 'kāmadevātmajāgrajaḥ' means 'the elder brother of Kāmadeva's son'. This implies Ramaṇa is Kāmadeva's elder (probably eldest) son, with an unnamed younger brother. The son_of relation is inferred from this. 'pakṣe durgāpriye' ('in the fortnight dear to Durgā') probably means the bright half of Āśvina (Navarātri). If so, the date would be Āśvina śukla caturthī, a Tuesday, but the month is not stated, so the month field is left empty. 'śrīśivasannidhau' ('in the presence of Śiva') probably refers to a Śiva shrine, not a named locality, so it is not normalized. 'sudhīḥ' is an epithet ('learned'), not a formal title.
